correctness.rationale: For the printed fiber \(\dot w=-3s-x,\ \dot s=w-ds\), the constant fiber polynomial is \(\lambda^2+d\lambda+3\), whose roots have strictly negative real parts for every \(d>0\). The vertical tangent subbundle is invariant and the quotient variational cocycle is the 3D Sprott-C base, so the full Lyapunov spectrum is the base spectrum plus the two stable fiber exponents. The base has divergence -1 and, on a non-equilibrium ergodic flow measure, one zero exponent, hence at most one positive exponent. Direct checks reproduce divergence \(-1-d\), the equilibria and characteristic factorization; at \(d=0.998\) the printed fiber has real part -0.499 while the plus-sign variant has +0.499.
residual_risks: The no-hyperchaos statement is for compact invariant dynamics with defined asymptotic Lyapunov exponents, not arbitrary finite-time transients.
